popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books IX–X and the Pylian contingent — Thrasymedes fights beside his father Nestor and stands watch on the night raid that steals Rhesus' horses.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book III — Telemachus finds Thrasymedes at Pylos among Nestor's sons, still present when the Odyssey turns from Troy to the nostos generation.

popCulture.title: Thrasymedes
popCulture.description: Son of Nestor who fights at Troy and returns to Pylos — Homer's Thrasymedes, not the later sculptor of the same name.
